title: Understanding CNN Layers: Convolution, ReLU, Pooling, and Flattening Explained

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to the intuition tutorials for the artificial neural networks part of the course.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到人工神經網路部分的概念課。

cues.en: Super excited to get these things started and today we're going to find out how we're going to tackle this section.
cues.zh: 很期待開始，今天看看這單元如何進行。

cues.en: So in this section, we will learn the following things.
cues.zh: 將學以下內容。

cues.en: First of all, we'll talk about the neuron.
cues.zh: 先談神經元。

cues.en: So there'll be a little bit of a neuroscience and we'll find out a bit about how the human brain works and why we are trying to replicate that.
cues.zh: 一些神經科學，了解人腦如何運作、為何想複製。

cues.en: And we'll also see what the main building block of a neural network, the neuron, looks like.
cues.zh: 也看神經網路主要建構單位，神經元的樣子。

cues.en: Then in the next tutorial, we'll talk about the activation function, and we'll look at a couple of examples of activation functions that you could use in your neural networks, and we'll find out which one
cues.zh: 下一堂談活化函數，看幾個可用的例子，找出哪個

cues.en: of them is the most commonly used one in neural networks and in which layers you would rather use which functions.
cues.zh: 最常用，各層適合哪些。

cues.en: Then we'll talk about how neural networks work.
cues.zh: 再談神經網路運作。

cues.en: So in contrast to what you would expect and what it is probably conveyed in other courses and tutorials, we're not going to go into the learning,
cues.zh: 可能不同於你的預期，或其他課程教法，不先談學習，

cues.en: we're actually going to go into the working of the neural networks first, because that way by seeing a neural network in action
cues.zh: 先看實際運作，觀察網路行動，

cues.en: that will allow us to understand what we're aiming towards what our goal is.
cues.zh: 讓我們了解目標。

cues.en: So here we'll look at an example of a neural network.
cues.zh: 看個神經網路例子。

cues.en: We're going to look at a very simplified, a very simplified hypothetical example of a neural network working to predict housing prices
cues.zh: 非常簡化的假想例，預測房價，

cues.en: or basically real estate prices.
cues.zh: 也就是不動產價格。

cues.en: And by looking at that example, we'll understand better exactly what we're aiming towards and what we want to achieve in the end.
cues.zh: 透過例子，更理解最終想達成什麼。

cues.en: And then we will move on to understanding how neural networks learn, because that way we'll be more prepared for what's coming.
cues.zh: 再了解如何學習，這樣準備更充分。

cues.en: Then we'll talk about gradient descent.
cues.zh: 接著梯度下降。

cues.en: This is also part of neural networks learning and we'll understand how that algorithm is better than just the brute force method
cues.zh: 也是學習一部分，了解為何比暴力搜尋好，

cues.en: that you might be intending or willing to take as a first resort or first method that comes to mind.
cues.zh: 而暴力搜尋可能是你第一個想到的方法。

cues.en: So we'll find out what the advantage of gradient descent are and then we'll talk about stochastic gradient descent.
cues.zh: 了解梯度下降優勢，再談隨機梯度下降。

cues.en: It's it's a continuation of the gradient descent tutorial, but it's a an even better and even stronger method and we'll find out exactly how it works.
cues.zh: 延續上一堂，但方法更好、更強，會明確理解運作。

cues.en: And finally, we'll wrap things up by mentioning the important things about back propagation and summarizing everything in a step by step set
cues.zh: 最後說反向傳播重點，把一切整理成逐步

cues.en: of instructions for running your artificial neural networks.
cues.zh: 執行人工神經網路的指示。

cues.en: I hope this all sounds very exciting to you because I am very excited myself and I can't wait to get started.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得精彩，我很期待，迫不及待。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you on the first tutorial, and until then, enjoy deep learning.
cues.zh: 第一堂見，在那之前，祝你享受深度學習的樂趣。
